headline: PNC Media notifies exchange about postal ballot
hook: Postal ballot notice sent to shareholders
summary: PNC Media and Entertainment Limited has submitted a notice regarding a postal ballot to the stock exchange. The filing pertains to upcoming shareholder voting procedures for corporate resolutions. Such notices outline the agenda items that require shareholder approval through remote voting. Retail investors holding the stock should review the specific proposals once details are made available.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate governance filing with no immediate price impact.

headline: PNC Media re-appoints Neerja Shah as independent director
summary: PNC Media and Entertainment Limited has announced the re-appointment of Ms Neerja Shah as an Independent Director for a second consecutive five-year term. The new term begins on February 23, 2027, and will conclude on February 22, 2032. This routine corporate governance update ensures board stability for the media firm over the long term. Indian retail investors generally track board composition changes for governance compliance, though this procedural filing has minimal direct impact on stock performance.
why_it_matters: Board continuity secured for the next decade.
